translation.name: Biblica® Open Nkanda wu Moyo, Nguizani Yimona ayi Minkunga 2002
translation.englishName: Yombe: Biblica® Open Nkanda wu Moyo, Nguizani Yimona ayi Minkunga 2002 (Bible)

content.text: Vuika ntinu fuanana kuaku, a Nzambi
kuidi muana ntinu busonga buaku !
Niandi wela sambisa batu baku mu busonga
ayi batu baku badi mu phasi mu bufuana.
Miongo miela natina batu mamboti ;
ayi zikhundubula ziela nata mimbutu mi busonga.
Wela vavila batu mu phasi va khatitsika batu
ayi wela vukisa bana bansukami
wela kosikisa mutu wunyamisanga batu.
Bela kanga ntima thangu bu yikidi
ngondi bu yikidi mu zitsungi zioso.
Niangi wela ba banga mvula yinnokina mu tsola yisolo,
banga mabeti ma disala mambua mu ntoto.
Mu bilumbu biandi, mutu wusonga wela mona mamboti,
mamboti mela yilama
nate ngondi yela zimbala.
Wela yadilanga tona ku mbu nate ku mbu wunkaka ;
ayi tona ku nlangu wunneni nate kuna zitsuka zi ntoto.
Makanda ma dikanga mela
buongama va ntualꞌandi ayi bambeni bandi
ziela venda fundu-fundu.
Mintinu mi Talisi ayi mi bisanga bidi thama
miela kunnatina phaku
Mintinu mi Saba ayi mi Seba
miela kumvana makaba.
Mintinu mioso miela buongama va ntualꞌandi
ayi makanda moso mela kunsadilanga.
Bila wela kula nsukami wulembo yamikina ;
mutu widi mu phasi kambulu mutu wulenda sadisa.
Wela mona mutu wulebakana ayi nsukami kiadi
ayi wela vukisa minsukami mu lufua.
Wela kula kuba kula mu khuamusu ayi mu makhemi
ayi menga mawu thalu madi va meso mandi.
Bika kazinga !
Bika baba kumvana nolo yela ba ku Saba ;
Bika batu bansambila mu zithangu zioso,
ayi bela kunsakumuna mu lumbu kimvimba.
Bika makundi maba mawombo mu tsi
nate va mbata miongo
ayi bika mimbutu miandi mibuta banga Lebanoni
bika miba mimboti banga biti bi tsola.
Bika dizina diandi dizingila mu zithangu zioso ;
bika dizina diandi dizinga thangu bu yikidi lezama.
Makanda moso mela sakumunu mu niandi
ayi bela kuntedila mutu wu lusakumunu.
Nzitusu wuba kuidi Yave Nzambi
Nzambi yi Iseli,
Bila niandi veka kaka wumvanganga matsiminanga.
Nzitusu wuba kuidi dizina diandi
di nkembo mu zithangu zioso
Bika ntoto wumvimba wuwala nkembo andi !
Vava vasukila zitsambulu zi Davidi, muana Yese.
